_readme: Item override examples, DELETE these files after creating your own as they are always in effect.
_Toggle_readme: You can add an Underscore _ to the beginning of a value to disable the changes(or delete the entry)
_DescriptionText_readme: Unique to each item even if vanilla is shared.
_Icon_readme: Must always be a *.png, use a file in Icons, URL, or existing item's Icon.
_CookbookModule_readme: If you have Cookbook StackSize can be added to the attributes
